paragraphs: Mueller Water Products supplies flow control and monitoring equipment for water systems. Its buyers are utilities alongside industrial and commercial operators of water and gas infrastructure. It also sells a water intelligence platform meant to show a utility the condition of its distribution network.

Its case studies center on acoustics used to locate underground leaks on water mains without digging. The same acoustic work is described as helping a city decide which repairs and replacements come first. Other accounts cover advanced metering deployments and cuts in non-revenue water.

For public buyers, the company points to certification under Build America Buy America. It publishes a sustainability report covering its 2025 results. It also puts out a handbook on aging infrastructure for utilities working on water loss.

quote.text: To make intelligent decisions on your water infrastructure, you need data intelligence.
